items.exampleEn: We walk through the park to school.

items.exampleZh: 我們的老師總是幫助我們。

items.exampleEn: The bird flies over the house.
It is late, but he is still at work.
items.exampleZh: 已經很晚了，但他還在上班。

items.exampleEn: I need a new pair of shoes.

items.sentenceEn: You should go to bed now.

items.audioEn: After school, Paul walks through the park with us.
items.audioZh: 放學後，Paul 和我們一起穿過公園。
items.questionZh: 放學後 Paul 做什麼？

items.stemEn: You look tired. You ____ go to bed early.
items.stemZh: 你看起來很累，你應該早點睡。

items.passageEn: Paul is our new classmate. After school, he goes home with us. We walk through a small park and over a bridge. Paul is still new here, so he needs our help. He says we should go to the park again on Sunday.
items.passageZh: Paul 是我們的新同學。放學後，他和我們一起回家。我們穿過一座小公園，走過一座橋。Paul 對這裡還不熟，所以他需要我們幫忙。他說我們星期天應該再去公園。

questions.questionZh: Paul 為什麼需要大家幫忙？
options: 因為他住在很遠的小鎮

rubricZh: 主詞用 we，動詞用 need
need 後面直接接名詞 help

items.promptZh: 她下班後會打電話給你。
referenceEn: She will call you after work.
After work, she will call you.
rubricZh: 用 after 表示「在⋯之後」（例如 after work）
未來的事可寫，例如 will call、is going to call 等
